We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list of tuples). The result was a tuple of three strings? So three possible precursors. Choose one that can be further processed by next template 1914389. Good.

Now we need to apply template 1914390 to each of those? The order is fixed: after 1914389, we apply 1914390. We applied 1914390 to 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO' and got a precursor: 'CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1'.

Now apply template 149040 to that product? We attempted but got no result. Maybe need to apply 149040 to the other precursor from 1914389: 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'. That also gave no result.

Maybe the correct path is different. Perhaps we need to use 1914391 as final step. We haven't used 1914391 yet.
